summary: No concrete installer-harm evidence identified for rasterkit 1.0.0
details: Analysis of rasterkit 1.0.0 (PyPI) across 112 files produced no concrete indicators of supply-chain attack behavior: no exfiltration endpoints, no install-time or import-time remote fetch-and-execute, no credential-path reads, no lifecycle hooks invoking network I/O, no dropper or backdoor patterns were surfaced. Coverage of the tracing pass was incomplete, so absence of evidence should not be interpreted as a full clean bill, but no observed behavior warrants an advisory at this time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
